programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel in 'Simon the Superb', then in 'The Sub', Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk. (S3, ep 15)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy in 'Baby Mama Drama', then in 'Ballet Boys', when Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help their skills. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case. (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play in 'Kiss Conspiracy', then in 'House Guests', Alvin secretly decides to rent out their house for a Hawaiian home-swap. (S1, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin tells Theodore that he can turn rubbish into sweets in 'Alvin's Secret Powers', then in 'Warbie', The Chipmunks find a baby bird that's fallen from its nest. (S1, ep 24)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother in 'Big Bro Theodore', and in 'No Putts, No Glory', Alvin fools Theodore into believing he's good at mini golf which of course backfires. (S4, ep 10)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette and the Chipmunks rescue a chimpanzee in 'Chimpmania', then in 'Dad Jokes', Dave will be hosting an auction where he'll have to tell jokes, but will Alvin tell him he's not funny? (S4, ep 19)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon is ecstatic when he's elected the school's safety monitor in "To Serve and Protect", then in "Kickin' It Old School", Dave takes away the Chipmunks technology during a camping trip. (S1, ep 7)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off in 'He Said She Said', then in 'Attack of the Zombies', Alvin and Theodore try to protect their loved ones. (S2, ep 23)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin sneaks into Simon's new virtual reality game in 'The Chosen Chipmunk', then in 'Double Dangus', Officer Dangus has a twin brother that's a bully, which will not do. (S4, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him in 'Alvin's Wild Weekend', then in 'For Whom the Bell Tolls', a hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool! (S2, ep 8)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's teddy bear gets bear-napped in 'Switcheroo', and in 'The Paperboy', when Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay. (S3, ep 18)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin kidnaps Simon's robot Geizmo in 'Geizmo's Day Out', then in 'Unbored', when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy. (S4, ep 25)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure. (S2, ep 22)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Jeanette signs The Chipmunks and Chipettes up for a competition in 'Going Green', then in 'Tattle Tail', Alvin likes a girl at school so he agrees to look after her talking bird. (S1, ep 18)

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul-mate in 'Albrittina', then in 'Simon for President', Simon and Alvin decide to launch their own campaigns for class president. (S1, ep 6)
